title.headline: 20 merger filings. Theories of harm, cited.

end.line: Quillon for Lachlan Moore’s competition team

vo: Lachlan Moore’s competition team runs about twenty merger filings a year. Here is that work in Quillon.
Vault reviews tens of thousands of internal documents at once, and the ones that matter come back flagged in one table.
Ask for a theory of harm, and the answer comes back cited to the page, with the source document open beside it.
Ask one question across a whole filing, and Quillon reads every document in the matter before it answers.
Isla will walk your team through it on Monday the twenty-third.
